TEAL-BLACK GLOOM — deep teal-black water fading to total darkness below, faint blue-green light filtering weakly from far above.
BIOLUM BLUE SUFFUSION — eerie soft bioluminescent blue suffuses the depth, cold and sourceless, silhouetting the ornate hull in spectral quiet.
ABYSS-GLOW ALONE — near-total black surrounds the submarine, only its own amber portholes casting any light into the void.
SILT-HAZE MURK — a hazy greenish gloom, thick with suspended silt, swallowing detail beyond a few fathoms in every direction.
CATHEDRAL BLUE OPEN — cold cathedral-blue fills the great open depth, vast and still, the water itself luminous with pressured silence.
WARM-COLD GRADIENT — gold lamplight bleeds from the portholes into surrounding water, fading hard into blue-black cold within yards.
GREEN PARTICLE MURK — green-tinged murk thick with drifting motes, each one catching dim light, the visibility closing to almost nothing.
FAR-ABOVE FILTER — a ghost of blue-green sunlight reaches down from impossibly far above, barely touching the blackness beneath the keel.
DEEP TEAL FADE — the water holds a deep teal tone near the surface layer, bleeding to utter darkness fifty feet down.
BIOLUM DRIFT — scattered bioluminescent organisms drift past in cold blue clusters, their faint glow the only color in the black.
PORTHOLE GOLD BLEED — warm amber porthole light bleeds into surrounding cold blue-black, the gradient sharp as a held breath.
SILT COLUMN LIGHT — weak diffuse light catches suspended silt columns, turning the murk a pale greenish-grey, dense and directionless.
ABYSSAL PRESSURE DARK — absolute near-black presses in from every side, the submarine's running lights carving thin tunnels through the nothing.
COLD CATHEDRAL VAULT — blue cathedral-cold fills the open water column like a vast interior, quiet and enormous and profoundly still.
TEAL PARTICLE FIELD — teal-dark water alive with drifting particles catching the last weak surface light, the scene dissolving below.
BIOLUM SILHOUETTE BLUE — cold sourceless blue bioluminescence silhouettes riveted hull plates, every ornate fitting thrown into brief ghostly relief.
MURK GREEN CLOSE — green-tinged murk crowds close, reducing the visible world to a soft-edged bubble of uncertain dim color.
WARM PORTHOLE CORONA — a warm gold corona surrounds each porthole, swallowed within feet by the surrounding blue-black indifference of depth.
SURFACE GHOST LIGHT — the faintest blue-green memory of surface light filters down from above, more rumor than illumination, fading fast.
ABYSS RIM DARK — the sub hangs at the abyss rim, its glow the sole warm note against an absolute cold black.
DEEP GREEN SUSPENSION — a green suspension of particles and dim light turns the water dense, intimate, and slightly suffocating in tone.
TEAL-TO-VOID — teal upper water grades cleanly to total void below the hull, the transition sharp and quietly absolute.
BIOLUM PULSE FIELD — a field of pulsing bioluminescent blue shifts the whole scene into cold unreality, motes drifting like slow embers.
SILT-DIFFUSE GREY-GREEN — diffuse grey-green silt-light flattens all shadow, the murk uniform and close, the world reduced to nearby hull-plates.
COLD-BLUE IMMENSITY — cold blue water opens in every direction without bottom or ceiling, depth made visible, the sub small and alone.
